item.title: NewsBiscuit Car Review: The all new Keir Stormer
item.description: There were high expectations on this new model, in this case SiR Stormer. The build up to the launch was preceded by genuine positive expectations, however it turns out that this version is a bit of a let down, offering little joy and disappointing performance.
